description: Fires when the left half of the board (columns 0-3, including the center) is full or nearly full, with column 0 especially important, while columns 4-6 are still fairly empty. Strongest when the last move went into a left column (e.g. topping off column 0); weaker when the last move was low in column 4 or 5 or the right side is also filling up. Partly-filled left halves, or a full right half, do not fire.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to max or zero changes move probabilities by at most ~0.09 (slight shift between columns 4 and 6 in one position), usually under 0.03.
notes: Layer-1 unit. Best dev F1 0.640 (P 0.70, R 0.59, AUROC 0.79), simulation share 0.28. Minimal pairs: needs all of columns 0-3 near full (any three full gives ~0.2); col0 matters most; mirror image does not fire; move order irrelevant; last-move column modulates strongly but inconsistently (col 4/5 suppress). Unexplained: some early-game firing with a vertical pair in column 0 (sequence-specific) and boards with a single low middle column. Steering effect negligible. Synthesis 4.65 beats dev max 4.34.
